data.name: Kripashankar
data.gender_notes: Kripashankar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the words Kripa, Ishvara, and Shankar. Kripa means cruel or merciful, Ishvara represents God or the supreme being, and Shankar signifies mercy or compassion. The name Kripashankar therefore embodies the idea of a powerful, compassionate deity. The name Kripashankar carries the meaning “Cruel (Kripa) + God (Ishvara) + Mercy (Shankar)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kripashankar usually hope their child will grow to embody cruel (kripa) + god (ishvara) + mercy (shankar) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kripashankar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cruel (Kripa) + God (Ishvara) + Mercy (Shankar).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kripashankar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name might also bring to mind various Hindu gods and deities associated with compassion, mercy, and punishment, such as Lord Krishna or Lord Vishnu.
